features.name: name_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator if raw business names are strictly identical.

features.name: name_clean_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator if cleaned business names are identical.

features.name: name_canonical_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator if canonicalized business roots are identical.

features.name: name_token_jaccard
features.description: Jaccard similarity between unique business name token sets.

features.name: name_token_overlap_count
features.description: Count of shared distinct tokens between business names.

features.name: name_token_containment
features.description: Fraction of shorter name tokens contained in longer name.

features.name: name_char_ngram_cosine
features.description: Character 3-gram TF-IDF cosine similarity between names.

features.name: name_levenshtein_sim
features.description: Normalized Levenshtein edit similarity between canonical names.

features.name: name_length_ratio
features.description: Ratio of shorter canonical name length to longer name length.

features.name: name_numeric_overlap
features.description: Jaccard overlap of numbers occurring inside business names.

features.name: address_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator if raw addresses are strictly identical.

features.name: address_clean_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator if cleaned addresses are identical.

features.name: address_canonical_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator if standardized canonical addresses are identical.

features.name: address_token_jaccard
features.description: Jaccard similarity between address token sets.

features.name: address_token_overlap_count
features.description: Count of shared distinct tokens between addresses.

features.name: address_char_ngram_cosine
features.description: Character 3-gram TF-IDF cosine similarity between addresses.

features.name: address_levenshtein_sim
features.description: Normalized Levenshtein edit similarity between canonical addresses.

features.name: address_numeric_jaccard
features.description: Jaccard similarity between numeric tokens in addresses (house/plot numbers).

features.name: address_numeric_contradiction
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if both addresses specify numbers but share 0 overlap.

features.name: address_postal_code_match
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if both postal/PIN codes match, 0.0 otherwise.

features.name: address_is_missing
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if either anchor or candidate address is missing.

features.name: country_exact_match
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if canonical country matches.

features.name: country_compatible
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if countries match or either is missing.

features.name: country_contradiction
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if both countries present but non-matching.

features.name: has_unseen_country
features.description: Binary indicator: 1.0 if either country was not observed in training.

features.name: name_and_address_high_sim
features.description: Binary composite: name_jaccard >= 0.70 AND address_jaccard >= 0.50.

features.name: name_high_address_contradiction
features.description: Binary composite: high name match with address numeric contradiction.

features.name: name_exact_diff_country
features.description: Binary contradiction: exact name match across conflicting countries.

features.name: overall_composite_similarity
features.description: Weighted linear harmonic mean of name, address, and country scores.

features.name: in_standard_blocker
features.description: Binary indicator if pair was retrieved by standard inverted index.

features.name: in_tfidf_retriever
features.description: Binary indicator if pair was retrieved by TF-IDF retriever.

features.name: in_both_retrieval_passes
features.description: Binary indicator if pair was captured in both retrieval passes.

features.name: tfidf_retrieval_score
features.description: Cosine similarity score from TF-IDF retrieval (0.0 if not in pass).
